The inventory includes reconstruction, classification gates, participation and contact bounds, event documentation, evidence distinctions, traceability, gap treatment and conditional trial documentation. It excludes deleted sampling, questioning, intervention, randomization and access prescriptions.

Continuity, possible corroboration and contradictions contribute to U02; separately recorded substantive reports contribute to U01. Gap labels and trial event distinctions remain operational constraints. Proposed-observation status remains insufficiency-only.

Positive conditional household explanations occur in U01; conditional attribution, documented-history accounting and missing-link consequences occur in U02. Gap classification is an actual constraint; aggregate explanatory insufficiency is not productive by itself.

The inventory covers linkage-dependent exclusion, agreed contact and withdrawal stopping, completeness and gap insufficiencies, specific reliability dependencies, selection and temporal-attribution limits, consumption insufficiency and deadline reporting. Deleted trial suspension, follow-up-window, purchasing and later-assessment claims are unused.
